*Every term traces to its source. The fit vote (0.65) is a model judgment, not a record — it reflects the fit between the candidate's backend/data SWE background and a Staff MLE bar. If you don't agree with that estimate, change it and re-run.*

## What This Run Could Not Check

- Whether Cohere Health's current ML team hires practitioners — H-1B history says they did historically; current team culture requires internal contacts or JD reading to confirm.
- Whether the Staff MLE role requires a PhD — JD must be read manually; no local data source for this.
- Whether the timeline multiplier (1.0) will hold — OPT hasn't started yet (2026-09-08); sponsorship timing depends on the company's H-1B filing cycle, which this run does not model.
- Kensho, Attentive Mobile, Zoom posting liveness — Workday limitation and missing URLs.
- Whether Moloco's full-time MLE roles (vs. the intern role checked) are practitioner-accessible — the intern posting was live but the JD note says full-time requires MS/PhD.
- Hybrid company (Kinetic Automation) — flagged for manual review; not scored.
